ns2:section.sectionText: Placement in this course requires a recent, adequate score on a U of I placement exam. For dates and details see http://math.illinois.edu/ALEKS. Students not meeting the ALEKS prerequisite will be dropped during the second week of the semester. Exams in this class will take place Wed, Feb 24; Tues, Mar 23; and Wed, Apr 21. Each exam is 60 minutes (1 hour), opening at 5 PM Central Time and must be completed by 11:59 PM Central Time.
